decisions.choice: the second lot: the second of the seven lots cast at Shiloh
decisions.reason: Joshua had men survey the land still to be divided and write it down in seven parts, and then he cast lots for them before the LORD at Shiloh (18:1-10). The first lot fell to Benjamin (18:11). Casting lots left the choice to God (Proverbs 16:33), so each tribe received its land as his gift and not by its own claim. This chapter gives the other six lots in turn.

decisions.choice: in the midst of the inheritance of Judah: Simeon has no region of its own
decisions.reason: Simeon's towns lie inside the southern part of Judah's land, and most of them already appear in Judah's list (15:26-32, 42). Verse 9 gives the reason. Behind it stands Jacob's word about Simeon and Levi: "I will divide them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel" (Genesis 49:7).

decisions.choice: inheritance: land given to a family as a lasting possession
decisions.reason: The word names property that passes down within a family from one generation to the next. Israel's land was divided among tribes, clans and families as a gift from God that was to stay in the family (Numbers 26:52-56; 27:1-11). It was received, not earned or bought.

decisions.choice: the tribe of Simeon, clan by clan
alternatives: the tribe of the descendants of Simeon
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the tribe of the sons of Simeon by their clans". Literal keeps "sons" with the gender setting, since the tribe was its men, women and children. Balanced and Readable say "the tribe of Simeon", since "sons of Simeon" is simply the tribe's name, and "clan by clan", since the land was shared out among the clans within the tribe. The same wording is used for every tribe in this chapter.

decisions.choice: the lot was drawn; share of land
decisions.reason: Readable says the lot "was drawn" and calls the inheritance a "share of land", which young readers can picture. It does so for every tribe in this chapter.

decisions.choice: "salió la suerte" (L, B); "se echó la suerte" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says the lot "came out", as from the vessel in which the lots were shaken; Literal and Balanced keep that, and Readable says the lot was cast for the tribe, as the English Readable says "was drawn". The same opening returns for each of the seven tribes in this chapter.

decisions.choice: "Thăm ... trúng ra" (Literal); "trúng" (Balanced); "được bắt cho" (Readable) for the lot coming out
decisions.reason: The lot that comes out names the tribe that gets the next share; Readable says plainly that the lot was drawn, as the English does. The same words are used for each of the seven lots in this chapter.

decisions.choice: saiu a segunda sorte (L); o segundo sorteio saiu para (B), foi para (R); a parte da terra (R)
decisions.reason: The lot formula of 18:11 for the seven tribes of this chapter: Literal follows the Hebrew verb, "saiu" here and "subiu" where the Hebrew says "came up" (verse 10), Balanced says "o sorteio saiu" and Readable "o sorteio foi", as 13:6 and 15:1 say "sorteio" at those levels. Readable calls the inheritance "a parte da terra", as the English Readable says "share of land" through the chapter (r-en-2).

decisions.choice: Sheba: kept as in the Hebrew text, though it may repeat the end of the name before it
decisions.reason: With Sheba the list in verses 2-6 has fourteen names, but verse 6 counts thirteen. The same list in 1 Chronicles 4:28 has "Beersheba, Moladah" with no Sheba, and Judah's list has Shema next to Moladah (15:26). Sheba may be a copyist's repeat of the second half of "Beersheba", or another name for Shema. The "and" before it can also be read as "that is", making Sheba a short name for Beersheba itself. The Hebrew text is followed here.

decisions.choice: included
decisions.reason: The Hebrew opens the list with "and there was for them in their inheritance". Balanced and Readable say "included". The list runs on to verse 6, so each of these verses ends with a comma.

decisions.choice: cities and their villages: towns with the open settlements that belonged to them
decisions.reason: The word for "city" is used for any lasting settlement, from a walled town to a small one, and most of these were small. The "villages" were unwalled settlements, farms and hamlets around a town that depended on it (Leviticus 25:31). "Their villages" means the villages of these towns.

decisions.choice: In all, there were ... with their villages
decisions.reason: Readable closes the list with a short sentence of its own. It does the same with each total in the chapter.

decisions.reason: Ether and Ashan are listed with Judah's towns in the western foothills (15:42), so Simeon's towns lay in two areas: the Negev in the south and a smaller group to the north-west.

decisions.reason: The Hebrew starts the second list with no joining word. Balanced adds "and also" to tie it to the first list, and Readable starts a new sentence.

source.text: וְכָל־הַֽחֲצֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר סְבִיבוֹת֙ הֶֽעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עַד־בַּֽעֲלַ֥ת בְּאֵ֖ר רָ֣אמַת נֶ֑גֶב זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־שִׁמְע֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and all the villages which [were] around the cities the these as far as Baalath-beer, Ramah of [the] Negev. This [was the] inheritance of [the] tribe of [the] sons of Simeon by their clans.

en.L: and all the villages that [were] around these cities, as far as Baalath-beer, Ramah of [the] Negev. This [was] the inheritance of the tribe of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Simeon by their clans.
en.B: together with all the villages around these towns, out to Baalath-beer, Ramah of the Negev. This was the inheritance of the tribe of Simeon, clan by clan.
en.R: It also included all the villages around these towns, as far as Baalath-beer, which is Ramah in the Negev, the dry land in the south. This was the share of land that the tribe of Simeon received, clan by clan.

sw.L: na vijiji vyote [vilivyokuwa] kandokando ya miji hii, hadi Baalath-beeri, Rama ya Negebu. Huu [ndio] urithi wa kabila la wana wa Simeoni kufuatana na koo zao.
sw.B: pamoja na vijiji vyote vilivyoizunguka miji hiyo, hadi Baalath-beeri, Rama ya Negebu. Huu ndio urithi wa kabila la Simeoni, ukoo kwa ukoo.
sw.R: Ilijumuisha pia vijiji vyote vilivyoizunguka miji hiyo, hadi Baalath-beeri, yaani Rama ya Negebu, nchi kavu ya kusini. Hii ndiyo sehemu ya nchi ambayo kabila la Simeoni lilipokea, ukoo kwa ukoo.

es.L: y todas las aldeas que [estaban] alrededor de estas ciudades, hasta Baalat-beer, Ramá del Néguev. Esta [es] la heredad de la tribu de los hijos de Simeón conforme a sus clanes.
es.B: junto con todas las aldeas alrededor de estas poblaciones, hasta Baalat-beer, Ramá del Néguev. Esta fue la heredad de la tribu de Simeón, clan por clan.
es.R: También incluía todas las aldeas alrededor de estos pueblos, hasta Baalat-beer, que es Ramá del Néguev, la tierra seca del sur. Esta fue la parte de la tierra que recibió la tribu de Simeón, clan por clan.

fr.L: et tous les villages qui [étaient] autour de ces villes jusqu’à Baalath-Béer, Rama du Néguev. Ceci [fut] l’héritage de la tribu des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Siméon selon leurs clans.
fr.B: avec tous les villages autour de ces villes, jusqu’à Baalath-Béer, Rama du Néguev. Tel fut l’héritage de la tribu de Siméon, clan par clan.
fr.R: Il comprenait aussi tous les villages autour de ces villes, jusqu’à Baalath-Béer, c’est-à-dire Rama du Néguev, la région sèche du sud. Voilà la part de terre que la tribu de Siméon a reçue, clan par clan.

vi.L: và tất cả các làng [ở] chung quanh các thành này, cho đến Ba-a-lát-Bê-e, Ra-ma của Nê-ghép. Đây [là] sản nghiệp của chi tộc con cháu Si-mê-ôn theo các gia tộc của họ.
vi.B: cùng với tất cả các làng chung quanh các thị trấn ấy, cho đến Ba-a-lát-Bê-e, tức Ra-ma của Nê-ghép. Đó là sản nghiệp của chi tộc Si-mê-ôn, theo từng gia tộc.
vi.R: Đất ấy cũng gồm tất cả các làng chung quanh các thị trấn ấy, cho đến Ba-a-lát-Bê-e, tức là Ra-ma ở Nê-ghép, vùng đất khô hạn ở miền nam. Đó là phần đất chi tộc Si-mê-ôn đã nhận, theo từng gia tộc.

ko.L: 그리고 이 성읍들 둘레에 있는 모든 마을이 바알랏 브엘, 곧 네겝의 라마까지 [있었다]. 이것이 시므온 자손 지파의 그들의 종족대로의 유산이다.
ko.B: 이 성읍들 둘레의 모든 마을도 바알랏 브엘, 곧 네겝의 라마까지 그들의 것이었다. 이것이 시므온 지파가 종족별로 받은 유산이다.
ko.R: 그 땅에는 이 성읍들 둘레에 있는 모든 마을도 들어 있었는데, 바알랏 브엘까지 이르렀다. 바알랏 브엘은 메마른 남쪽 땅 네겝에 있는 라마이다. 이것이 시므온 지파가 집안별로 받은 땅이다.

pt.L: e todas as aldeias que [estavam] ao redor destas cidades, até Baalate-Beer, Ramá do Neguebe. Esta [foi] a herança da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, segundo os seus clãs.
pt.B: junto com todas as aldeias ao redor dessas cidades, até Baalate-Beer, Ramá do Neguebe. Esta foi a herança da tribo de Simeão, clã por clã.
pt.R: Ela incluía também todas as aldeias ao redor dessas cidades, até Baalate-Beer, que é Ramá do Neguebe, a região seca do sul. Essa foi a parte da terra que a tribo de Simeão recebeu, clã por clã.

decisions.choice: Baalath-beer, Ramah of the Negev: two names for one place
decisions.reason: The second name explains the first. "Ramah" means "height". The place may be the Ramoth of the Negev to which David sent gifts (1 Samuel 30:27). It marks the farthest point of Simeon's villages.

decisions.choice: the Negev: the dry country of the south
decisions.reason: The Negev is the dry land south of the hill country of Judah, around Beersheba, where rain is scarce and towns stand by wells.

decisions.choice: This was the inheritance ...: the closing words for each tribe
decisions.reason: Each tribe's section ends with this summary (verses 16, 23, 31, 39, 48).

decisions.choice: which is ...; the dry land in the south
decisions.reason: Readable says that the two names are one place and explains the Negev, as the meaning decisions describe.

decisions.choice: Baalate-Beer, Ramá do Neguebe
decisions.reason: The Brazilian forms of the names: "Neguebe" as the book writes the region elsewhere in Portuguese, kept as a name at every level, with Readable explaining it (m2) as the English Readable does.

source.text: מֵחֶ֨בֶל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נַחֲלַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־הָיָ֞ה חֵ֤לֶק בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָה֙ רַ֣ב מֵהֶ֔ם וַיִּנְחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־שִׁמְע֖וֹן בְּת֥וֹךְ נַחֲלָתָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: From [the] portion of [the] sons of Judah [was the] inheritance of [the] sons of Simeon, for was [the] portion of [the] sons of Judah too great for them; and received inheritance [the] sons of Simeon in [the] midst of their inheritance.

en.L: From the portion of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah [was] the inheritance of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Simeon, for the portion of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah was too great for them, and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Simeon received an inheritance in the midst of their inheritance.
en.B: The inheritance of the tribe of Simeon came out of the share of the tribe of Judah, because Judah's share was too large for them. So the tribe of Simeon received its inheritance inside Judah's.
en.R: The land of Simeon was taken from Judah's share, because Judah had more land than it needed. So the tribe of Simeon received land inside the land of Judah.

sw.L: Kutoka fungu la wana wa Yuda [ulikuwa] urithi wa wana wa Simeoni, kwa maana fungu la wana wa Yuda lilikuwa kubwa mno kwao, na wana wa Simeoni wakapokea urithi katikati ya urithi wao.
sw.B: Urithi wa kabila la Simeoni ulitoka katika fungu la kabila la Yuda, kwa sababu fungu la Yuda lilikuwa kubwa mno kwao. Hivyo kabila la Simeoni lilipokea urithi wake ndani ya urithi wa Yuda.
sw.R: Nchi ya Simeoni ilichukuliwa kutoka katika fungu la Yuda, kwa sababu Yuda walikuwa na nchi kubwa kuliko walivyohitaji. Kwa hiyo kabila la Simeoni lilipokea nchi ndani ya nchi ya Yuda.

es.L: De la porción de los hijos de Judá [fue] la heredad de los hijos de Simeón, porque la porción de los hijos de Judá era demasiado grande para ellos; y los hijos de Simeón recibieron heredad en medio de su heredad.
es.B: La heredad de la tribu de Simeón salió de la parte de la tribu de Judá, porque la parte de Judá era demasiado grande para ellos. Así la tribu de Simeón recibió su heredad dentro de la de Judá.
es.R: La tierra de Simeón se tomó de la parte de Judá, porque Judá tenía más tierra de la que necesitaba. Así que la tribu de Simeón recibió tierra dentro de la tierra de Judá.

fr.L: De la portion des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda [fut] l’héritage des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Siméon, car la portion des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda était trop grande pour eux ; et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Siméon reçurent un héritage au milieu de leur héritage.
fr.B: L’héritage de la tribu de Siméon fut pris sur la part de la tribu de Juda, parce que la part de Juda était trop grande pour elle. La tribu de Siméon reçut donc son héritage à l’intérieur de celui de Juda.
fr.R: Le pays de Siméon a été pris sur la part de Juda, parce que Juda avait plus de terre qu’il ne lui en fallait. Ainsi, la tribu de Siméon a reçu des terres à l’intérieur du pays de Juda.

vi.L: Sản nghiệp của con cháu Si-mê-ôn [lấy] từ phần của con cháu Giu-đa, vì phần của con cháu Giu-đa quá lớn đối với họ; nên con cháu Si-mê-ôn nhận sản nghiệp ở giữa sản nghiệp của họ.
vi.B: Sản nghiệp của chi tộc Si-mê-ôn được lấy từ phần của chi tộc Giu-đa, vì phần của Giu-đa quá lớn đối với họ. Vì thế chi tộc Si-mê-ôn nhận sản nghiệp ở bên trong sản nghiệp của Giu-đa.
vi.R: Đất của Si-mê-ôn được lấy từ phần của Giu-đa, vì Giu-đa có nhiều đất hơn mức cần. Vì thế chi tộc Si-mê-ôn nhận đất ở bên trong đất Giu-đa.

ko.L: 시므온 자손의 유산은 유다 자손의 몫에서 [나왔으니], 유다 자손의 몫이 그들에게 너무 컸기 때문이다. 그리고 시므온 자손이 그들의 유산 가운데서 유산을 받았다.
ko.B: 시므온 지파의 유산은 유다 지파의 몫에서 떼어 낸 것이다. 유다 지파의 몫이 그들에게 너무 컸기 때문이다. 그래서 시므온 지파는 유다 지파의 유산 안에서 유산을 받았다.
ko.R: 시므온 지파의 땅은 유다 지파의 몫에서 떼어 낸 것이다. 유다 지파가 받은 땅이 그들에게 필요한 것보다 많았기 때문이다. 그래서 시므온 지파는 유다 지파의 땅 안에서 땅을 받았다.

pt.L: Da porção dos filhos de Judá [foi] a herança dos filhos de Simeão, porque a porção dos filhos de Judá era grande demais para eles; e os filhos de Simeão receberam herança no meio da herança deles.
pt.B: A herança da tribo de Simeão foi tirada da parte da tribo de Judá, porque a parte de Judá era grande demais para eles. Por isso, a tribo de Simeão recebeu a sua herança dentro da herança de Judá.
pt.R: A terra de Simeão foi tirada da parte de Judá, porque Judá tinha mais terra do que precisava. Por isso, a tribo de Simeão recebeu terra dentro da terra de Judá.

decisions.choice: portion: the part measured out
decisions.reason: This is a different word from "inheritance". It means a share or part that has been measured out, here the land first marked out for Judah (15:1-63).

decisions.choice: too great for them; their inheritance: Judah's
decisions.reason: "Them" and "their" are the people of Judah: their land was more than they could fill and hold, so part of it went to Simeon. Judah's share was the largest of all (chapter 15).

decisions.choice: more land than it needed
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "too great for them" means.

decisions.choice: a porção (L)
decisions.reason: The word is not "inheritance" but a share measured out (m1); Literal keeps the two apart with "porção" and "herança". Balanced and Readable say "parte", the plain word.

source.text: וַיַּ֨עַל֙ הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לִבְנֵ֥י זְבוּלֻ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיְהִ֛י גְּב֥וּל נַחֲלָתָ֖ם עַד־שָׂרִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: And came up the lot the third for [the] sons of Zebulun by their clans; and was [the] border of their inheritance as far as Sarid.

en.L: And the third lot came up for the {{gender:children|sons}} of Zebulun by their clans. And the border of their inheritance was as far as Sarid.
en.B: The third lot came up for the tribe of Zebulun, clan by clan. The border of their inheritance reached as far as Sarid.
en.R: The third lot was drawn for the tribe of Zebulun, clan by clan. Their border reached as far as Sarid.

sw.L: Na kura ya tatu ikapanda kwa wana wa Zabuloni kufuatana na koo zao. Na mpaka wa urithi wao ulikuwa hadi Saridi.
sw.B: Kura ya tatu ilitoka kwa kabila la Zabuloni, ukoo kwa ukoo. Mpaka wa urithi wao ulifika hadi Saridi.
sw.R: Kura ya tatu ilipigwa kwa ajili ya kabila la Zabuloni, ukoo kwa ukoo. Mpaka wao ulifika hadi Saridi.

es.L: Y subió la tercera suerte para los hijos de Zabulón conforme a sus clanes. Y la frontera de su heredad fue hasta Sarid.
es.B: La tercera suerte salió para la tribu de Zabulón, clan por clan. La frontera de su heredad llegaba hasta Sarid.
es.R: La tercera suerte se echó para la tribu de Zabulón, clan por clan. Su frontera llegaba hasta Sarid.

fr.L: Et le troisième sort monta pour les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Zabulon selon leurs clans. Et la frontière de leur héritage fut jusqu’à Sarid.
fr.B: Le troisième sort tomba sur la tribu de Zabulon, clan par clan. La frontière de son héritage allait jusqu’à Sarid.
fr.R: Le troisième tirage au sort a été pour la tribu de Zabulon, clan par clan. Sa frontière allait jusqu’à Sarid.

vi.L: Thăm thứ ba trúng ra cho con cháu Sa-bu-lôn theo các gia tộc của họ. Ranh giới sản nghiệp của họ là đến Sa-rít.
vi.B: Thăm thứ ba trúng chi tộc Sa-bu-lôn, theo từng gia tộc. Ranh giới sản nghiệp của họ chạy đến Sa-rít.
vi.R: Thăm thứ ba được bắt cho chi tộc Sa-bu-lôn, theo từng gia tộc. Ranh giới của họ chạy đến Sa-rít.

ko.L: 그리고 셋째 제비가 스불론 자손에게 그들의 종족대로 올라왔다. 그리고 그들의 유산의 경계는 사릿까지였다.
ko.B: 셋째 제비는 스불론 지파에게 종족별로 나왔다. 그들의 유산의 경계는 사릿까지 이르렀다.
ko.R: 셋째 제비는 스불론 지파에게 집안별로 뽑혔다. 그들의 경계는 사릿까지 이르렀다.

pt.L: E subiu a terceira sorte para os filhos de Zebulom, segundo os seus clãs; e a fronteira da herança deles foi até Saride.
pt.B: O terceiro sorteio saiu para a tribo de Zebulom, clã por clã. A fronteira da herança deles chegava até Saride.
pt.R: O terceiro sorteio foi para a tribo de Zebulom, clã por clã. A fronteira deles chegava até Saride.

decisions.choice: came up: the lot was drawn out
decisions.reason: Lots were drawn from a container or the fold of a garment, so a lot could be said to "come up" or "come out" (verse 1; Leviticus 16:9). The two verbs describe the same act.

decisions.choice: Zebulun's land and its starting point, Sarid
decisions.reason: Zebulun lay in the hills of lower Galilee, north of the Jezreel Valley, between Asher on the west and Naphtali on the east. Sarid, whose site is not certain, was on its southern edge; from there the border is traced first west (verse 11) and then east (verse 12).

decisions.choice: the tribe of Zebulun, clan by clan
decisions.reason: As in verse 1.

source.text: וְעָלָ֨ה גְבוּלָ֧ם׀לַיָּ֛מָּה וּמַרְעֲלָ֖ה וּפָגַ֣ע בְּדַבָּ֑שֶׁת וּפָגַע֙ אֶל־הַנַּ֔חַל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י יָקְנְעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And goes up their border westward and Maralah, and touches on Dabbesheth, and touches to the wadi which [is] on [the] face of Jokneam.

en.L: And their border goes up westward, and [to] Maralah, and touches Dabbesheth, and touches the wadi that [is] opposite Jokneam.
en.B: Their border goes up westward to Maralah, reaches Dabbesheth, and reaches the wadi that faces Jokneam.
en.R: Their border went up to the west, to Maralah. It reached Dabbesheth and the stream valley near Jokneam.

sw.L: Na mpaka wao unapanda kuelekea magharibi, na [hadi] Marala, na kugusa Dabeshethi, na kugusa korongo lililo mkabala na Yokneamu.
sw.B: Mpaka wao unapanda kuelekea magharibi hadi Marala, unafika Dabeshethi, na kufika kwenye korongo linaloelekeana na Yokneamu.
sw.R: Mpaka wao ulipanda kuelekea magharibi hadi Marala. Ulifika Dabeshethi na bonde la mkondo karibu na Yokneamu.

es.L: Y sube su frontera hacia el occidente, y [a] Marala, y toca Dabeset, y toca el torrente que [está] frente a Jocneam.
es.B: Su frontera sube hacia el occidente hasta Marala, llega a Dabeset y llega al torrente que está frente a Jocneam.
es.R: Su frontera subía hacia el oeste, hasta Marala. Llegaba a Dabeset y al valle del arroyo cerca de Jocneam.

fr.L: Et leur frontière monte vers l’occident, et [vers] Marala, et touche Dabbésheth, et touche le torrent qui [est] en face de Jokneam.
fr.B: Leur frontière monte vers l’ouest jusqu’à Marala, atteint Dabbésheth et atteint le torrent qui fait face à Jokneam.
fr.R: Leur frontière montait vers l’ouest, jusqu’à Marala. Elle arrivait à Dabbésheth et à la vallée du torrent près de Jokneam.

vi.L: Ranh giới của họ đi lên về phía tây, [đến] Ma-rê-a-la, chạm Đáp-bê-sết, và chạm khe đối diện Giốc-nê-am.
vi.B: Ranh giới của họ đi lên về phía tây đến Ma-rê-a-la, đến Đáp-bê-sết, và đến khe đối diện Giốc-nê-am.
vi.R: Ranh giới của họ đi lên về phía tây đến Ma-rê-a-la. Nó đến Đáp-bê-sết và lòng suối gần Giốc-nê-am.

ko.L: 그리고 그들의 경계는 서쪽으로 마랄라로 올라가서 답베셋에 닿고, 욕느암 맞은편에 있는 시내에 닿는다.
ko.B: 그들의 경계는 서쪽으로 마랄라까지 올라가서 답베셋에 이르고, 욕느암 맞은편의 시내에 이른다.
ko.R: 그들의 경계는 서쪽으로 마랄라까지 올라갔다. 그리고 답베셋과 욕느암 근처의 시냇골에 이르렀다.

pt.L: E a fronteira deles sobe para o oeste, e [até] Marala, e toca Dabesete, e toca o ribeiro que [está] em frente de Jocneão.
pt.B: A fronteira deles sobe para o oeste até Marala, chega a Dabesete e chega ao ribeiro que fica em frente de Jocneão.
pt.R: A fronteira deles subia para o oeste até Marala. Ela chegava a Dabesete e ao leito do ribeiro perto de Jocneão.

decisions.choice: westward and Maralah: westward, as far as Maralah
decisions.reason: The "and" joins the direction to the place the line reaches; the border climbed westward to Maralah.

decisions.choice: wadi: a stream bed that fills in the rainy season
decisions.reason: The word names a valley cut by a stream that runs with water in the winter rains and may be dry in summer. Jokneam, whose king Joshua defeated (12:22), stood where the hills of Carmel meet the Jezreel Valley.

decisions.choice: on the face of: facing, opposite
decisions.reason: The phrase means "in front of" or "facing", and it can also mean "east of".

decisions.choice: touches / reaches (L, B), reached (R); wadi / stream valley
decisions.reason: The verb means "to meet" or "touch". Literal keeps "touches"; Balanced and Readable say "reaches", which is how a border meets a place. Literal and Balanced keep "wadi", the name for such a valley; Readable says "stream valley". Literal and Balanced trace the line in the present tense and Readable in the past, as in 15:3. The same wording is used through the chapter.

decisions.choice: toca (L), chega a (B, R); o ribeiro (L, B), o leito do ribeiro (R)
decisions.reason: As 15:7 has the word for a seasonal stream valley (m2) in Portuguese, after Numbers 34:5: "ribeiro" at Literal and Balanced, and "o leito do ribeiro" at Readable, as the English Readable says "stream valley". "Tocar" keeps the Hebrew verb at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "chegar a", as the English says "reaches" (r-en-1).

source.text: וְשָׁ֣ב מִשָּׂרִ֗יד קֵ֚דְמָה מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ עַל־גְּב֥וּל כִּסְלֹ֖ת תָּבֹ֑ר וְיָצָ֥א אֶל־הַדָּֽבְרַ֖ת וְעָלָ֥ה יָפִֽיעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And turns back from Sarid eastward, toward [the] rising of the sun, to [the] border of Chisloth-tabor, and goes out to Daberath, and goes up [to] Japhia.

en.L: And it turns from Sarid eastward, toward the sunrise, to the border of Chisloth-tabor, and goes out to Daberath, and goes up to Japhia.
en.B: From Sarid it turns east, toward the sunrise, to the border of Chisloth-tabor, goes on to Daberath, and goes up to Japhia.
en.R: From Sarid the border also went east to the edge of Chisloth-tabor. It went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.

sw.L: Na unageuka kutoka Saridi kuelekea mashariki, kuelekea mawio ya jua, hadi mpaka wa Kisloth-tabori, na kutokea Daberathi, na kupanda hadi Yafia.
sw.B: Kutoka Saridi unageuka mashariki, kuelekea mawio ya jua, hadi mpaka wa Kisloth-tabori, unaendelea hadi Daberathi, na kupanda hadi Yafia.
sw.R: Kutoka Saridi mpaka ulienda pia upande wa mashariki hadi ukingo wa Kisloth-tabori. Ukaendelea hadi Daberathi na kupanda hadi Yafia.

es.L: Y gira desde Sarid al oriente, hacia la salida del sol, a la frontera de Quislot-tabor, y sale a Daberat, y sube a Jafía.
es.B: Desde Sarid gira al oriente, hacia la salida del sol, hasta la frontera de Quislot-tabor, sigue hasta Daberat y sube a Jafía.
es.R: Desde Sarid la frontera también iba hacia el este hasta el límite de Quislot-tabor. Seguía hasta Daberat y subía a Jafía.

fr.L: Et elle tourne de Sarid vers l’orient, vers le lever du soleil, vers la frontière de Kisloth-Thabor, et sort vers Daberath, et monte vers Japhia.
fr.B: De Sarid, elle tourne vers l’est, vers le soleil levant, jusqu’à la frontière de Kisloth-Thabor, continue vers Daberath et monte vers Japhia.
fr.R: De Sarid, la frontière allait aussi vers l’est jusqu’au bord de Kisloth-Thabor. Elle continuait jusqu’à Daberath et montait jusqu’à Japhia.

vi.L: Từ Sa-rít nó vòng về phía đông, về phía mặt trời mọc, đến ranh giới Kít-lốt-Tha-bô, đi ra Đa-bê-rát, và đi lên Gia-phia.
vi.B: Từ Sa-rít nó vòng về phía đông, về phía mặt trời mọc, đến ranh giới Kít-lốt-Tha-bô, tiếp đến Đa-bê-rát, rồi đi lên Gia-phia.
vi.R: Từ Sa-rít, ranh giới cũng đi về phía đông đến bờ Kít-lốt-Tha-bô. Nó tiếp đến Đa-bê-rát và lên Gia-phia.

ko.L: 그리고 그것은 사릿에서 동쪽으로, 해 뜨는 쪽으로 기슬롯 다볼의 경계로 돌아서, 다브랏으로 나가고 야비아로 올라간다.
ko.B: 경계는 사릿에서 동쪽, 해 뜨는 쪽으로 돌아서 기슬롯 다볼의 경계에 이르고, 다브랏으로 나가서 야비아로 올라간다.
ko.R: 경계는 사릿에서 동쪽으로도 뻗어 기슬롯 다볼의 경계에 이르렀다. 그리고 다브랏을 지나 야비아로 올라갔다.

pt.L: E volta de Saride para o oriente, para o nascer do sol, até a fronteira de Quislote-Tabor, e sai para Daberate, e sobe a Jafia.
pt.B: De Saride ela volta para o leste, para o nascer do sol, até a fronteira de Quislote-Tabor, segue até Daberate e sobe até Jafia.
pt.R: De Saride a fronteira também ia para o leste, até a divisa de Quislote-Tabor. Ela seguia até Daberate e subia até Jafia.

decisions.choice: turned from Sarid eastward: the line traced the other way from its starting point
decisions.reason: Verse 11 took the border west from Sarid; now it is traced east from the same point along the south side of Zebulun's land.

decisions.choice: Chisloth-tabor and Daberath, near Mount Tabor
decisions.reason: Chisloth-tabor ("slopes of Tabor") is probably the Chesulloth of Issachar's list (verse 18). Daberath, at the foot of Mount Tabor, was later given to the Levites from Issachar (21:28).

decisions.choice: leaves out "toward the sunrise"
decisions.reason: Readable gives the direction once, as "east", since "toward the sunrise" repeats it. It does the same in verse 13.

source.text: וּמִשָּׁ֤ם עָבַר֙ קֵ֣דְמָה מִזְרָ֔חָה גִּתָּ֥ה חֵ֖פֶר עִתָּ֣ה קָצִ֑ין וְיָצָ֛א רִמּ֥וֹן הַמְּתֹאָ֖ר הַנֵּעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And from there passes on eastward, toward sunrise, to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin; and goes out [to] Rimmon, the bending to Neah.

en.L: And from there it passes along eastward, toward the sunrise, to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin, and goes out to Rimmon, which bends toward Neah.
en.B: From there it goes on east, toward the sunrise, to Gath-hepher and Eth-kazin, and goes out to Rimmon, where it bends toward Neah.
en.R: From there it went on east to Gath-hepher and Eth-kazin. Then it went to Rimmon and turned toward Neah.

sw.L: Na kutoka huko unapita kuelekea mashariki, kuelekea mawio ya jua, hadi Gath-heferi, hadi Eth-kasini, na kutokea Rimoni, unaopinda kuelekea Nea.
sw.B: Kutoka huko unaendelea mashariki, kuelekea mawio ya jua, hadi Gath-heferi na Eth-kasini, na kutokea Rimoni, ambapo unapinda kuelekea Nea.
sw.R: Kutoka huko ulienda mashariki hadi Gath-heferi na Eth-kasini. Kisha ukaenda hadi Rimoni, ukageuka kuelekea Nea.

es.L: Y de allí pasa al oriente, hacia la salida del sol, a Gat-hefer, a Et-cazín, y sale a Rimón, que se curva hacia Nea.
es.B: De allí sigue al oriente, hacia la salida del sol, hasta Gat-hefer y Et-cazín, y sale a Rimón, donde se curva hacia Nea.
es.R: Desde allí seguía al este hasta Gat-hefer y Et-cazín. Luego iba a Rimón y giraba hacia Nea.

fr.L: Et de là elle passe vers l’orient, vers le lever du soleil, vers Gath-Hépher, vers Eth-Katsin, et sort vers Rimmon, qui s’infléchit vers Néa.
fr.B: De là, elle passe vers l’est, vers le soleil levant, jusqu’à Gath-Hépher et Eth-Katsin, et sort vers Rimmon, où elle s’incurve vers Néa.
fr.R: De là, elle allait vers l’est jusqu’à Gath-Hépher et Eth-Katsin. Puis elle allait jusqu’à Rimmon et tournait vers Néa.

vi.L: Từ đó nó đi qua về phía đông, về phía mặt trời mọc, đến Gát-Hê-phe, đến Ết-Ca-xin, rồi đi ra Rim-môn, [nơi] uốn về phía Nê-a.
vi.B: Từ đó nó đi tiếp về phía đông, về phía mặt trời mọc, đến Gát-Hê-phe và Ết-Ca-xin, rồi ra đến Rim-môn, nơi nó uốn về phía Nê-a.
vi.R: Từ đó nó đi tiếp về phía đông đến Gát-Hê-phe và Ết-Ca-xin. Rồi nó đến Rim-môn và quay về phía Nê-a.

ko.L: 그리고 거기에서 동쪽으로, 해 뜨는 쪽으로 가드 헤벨로, 엣 가신으로 지나가고, 네아 쪽으로 굽어지는 림몬으로 나간다.
ko.B: 거기에서 동쪽, 해 뜨는 쪽으로 가드 헤벨과 엣 가신으로 지나가고, 림몬으로 나가서 네아 쪽으로 굽어진다.
ko.R: 거기에서 경계는 동쪽으로 가드 헤벨과 엣 가신까지 갔다. 그다음에 림몬으로 가서 네아 쪽으로 돌았다.

pt.L: E dali passa para o oriente, para o nascer do sol, a Gate-Héfer, a Ete-Cazim; e sai a Rimom, que se estende até Neá.
pt.B: Dali ela segue para o leste, para o nascer do sol, até Gate-Héfer e Ete-Cazim, e sai em Rimom, onde faz uma curva em direção a Neá.
pt.R: Dali ela seguia para o leste até Gate-Héfer e Ete-Cazim. Depois ia até Rimom e virava em direção a Neá.

decisions.choice: Rimmon, which bends toward Neah: the border bends at Rimmon
decisions.reason: The word after Rimmon is a form of a verb meaning "to be marked out" or "to stretch". It most likely tells how the border runs: from Rimmon it turns toward Neah. It has also been read as part of a longer place name.

decisions.choice: Gath-hepher: the home town of Jonah
decisions.reason: The prophet Jonah son of Amittai came from Gath-hepher (2 Kings 14:25).

decisions.choice: Gate-Héfer, Ete-Cazim, Rimom, Neá
decisions.reason: The usual Brazilian forms; "Gate-Héfer" as the home town of Jonah is known in Portuguese (2 Kings 14:25), and "Rimom" with the final -om of the book's other names.

source.text: וְנָסַ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ הַגְּב֔וּל מִצְּפ֖וֹן חַנָּתֹ֑ן וְהָיוּ֙ תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֔יו גֵּ֖י יִפְתַּח־אֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And turns around it the border on [the] north [to] Hannathon; and were its ends [the] valley of Iphtah-el.

en.L: And the border goes around it on the north to Hannathon, and its end is at the valley of Iphtah-el.
en.B: On the north the border goes around to Hannathon and ends at the valley of Iphtah-el.
en.R: On the north side, the border went around to Hannathon and ended at the valley of Iphtah-el.

sw.L: Na mpaka unauzunguka upande wa kaskazini hadi Hanathoni, na mwisho wake ni bonde la Ifta-eli.
sw.B: Upande wa kaskazini mpaka unazunguka hadi Hanathoni na kuishia kwenye bonde la Ifta-eli.
sw.R: Upande wa kaskazini, mpaka ulizunguka hadi Hanathoni, ukaishia kwenye bonde la Ifta-eli.

es.L: Y la frontera la rodea por el norte hasta Hanatón, y sus salidas están en el valle de Jefte-el.
es.B: Por el norte la frontera da la vuelta hasta Hanatón y termina en el valle de Jefte-el.
es.R: Por el lado norte, la frontera daba la vuelta hasta Hanatón y terminaba en el valle de Jefte-el.

fr.L: Et la frontière la contourne au nord vers Hannathon, et ses issues sont à la vallée de Jiphtah-El.
fr.B: Au nord, la frontière contourne jusqu’à Hannathon et aboutit à la vallée de Jiphtah-El.
fr.R: Du côté nord, la frontière faisait le tour jusqu’à Hannathon et se terminait à la vallée de Jiphtah-El.

vi.L: Ranh giới vòng quanh nó ở phía bắc đến Ha-na-thôn, và cuối của nó là ở thung lũng Díp-thách-Ên.
vi.B: Ở phía bắc ranh giới vòng đến Ha-na-thôn và dừng lại ở thung lũng Díp-thách-Ên.
vi.R: Ở phía bắc, ranh giới vòng đến Ha-na-thôn và dừng lại ở thung lũng Díp-thách-Ên.

ko.L: 그리고 경계는 북쪽으로 그것을 돌아 한나돈으로 가고, 그 끝은 입다엘 골짜기이다.
ko.B: 북쪽으로는 경계가 한나돈으로 돌아서 입다엘 골짜기에서 끝난다.
ko.R: 북쪽에서는 경계가 한나돈으로 돌아서 입다엘 골짜기에서 끝났다.

pt.L: E a fronteira a contorna pelo norte até Hanatom, e o seu extremo é no vale de Iftá-El.
pt.B: Do lado norte, a fronteira contorna até Hanatom e termina no vale de Iftá-El.
pt.R: Do lado norte, a fronteira contornava até Hanatom e terminava no vale de Iftá-El.

decisions.choice: goes around it: around the territory
decisions.reason: "It" is most likely Zebulun's land: the line now curves round from the east side to the north.

decisions.choice: its ends: where the border line runs out
decisions.reason: The word names the end point of a border line. It closes the lines in verses 22, 29 and 33 as well.

decisions.choice: the valley of Iphtah-el: where Zebulun met Asher
decisions.reason: Asher's border also reaches this valley (verse 27), so it marked the meeting point of the two tribes on the north-west.

decisions.choice: its end is at (L); ends at (B); ended at (R)
decisions.reason: For "its ends were", Literal says "its end is at", as in Numbers 34:5 and 15:4; Balanced says "ends at" and Readable "ended at", here and through the chapter.

source.text: וְקַטָּ֤ת וְנַֽהֲלָל֙ וְשִׁמְר֔וֹן וְיִדְאֲלָ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית לָ֑חֶם עָרִ֥ים שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And Kattath and Nahalal and Shimron and Idalah and Bethlehem: cities twelve and their villages.

en.L: And Kattath, and Nahalal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities and their villages.
en.B: Also in it were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah and Bethlehem: twelve towns and their villages.
en.R: Its land also included Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah and Bethlehem. In all, there were twelve towns with their villages.

sw.L: Na Katathi, na Nahalali, na Shimroni, na Idala, na Bethlehemu: miji kumi na miwili na vijiji vyake.
sw.B: Ndani yake pia kulikuwa na Katathi, Nahalali, Shimroni, Idala na Bethlehemu: miji kumi na miwili pamoja na vijiji vyake.
sw.R: Nchi yao ilijumuisha pia Katathi, Nahalali, Shimroni, Idala na Bethlehemu. Kwa jumla ilikuwa miji kumi na miwili pamoja na vijiji vyake.

es.L: Y Catat, y Naalal, y Simrón, e Idala, y Belén: doce ciudades y sus aldeas.
es.B: También estaban en ella Catat, Naalal, Simrón, Idala y Belén: doce poblaciones y sus aldeas.
es.R: Su tierra incluía también Catat, Naalal, Simrón, Idala y Belén. En total, eran doce pueblos con sus aldeas.

fr.L: Et Kattath et Nahalal et Shimron et Jidala et Bethléem : douze villes et leurs villages.
fr.B: Il y avait aussi Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Jidala et Bethléem : douze villes et leurs villages.
fr.R: Son pays comprenait aussi Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Jidala et Bethléem. En tout, il y avait douze villes avec leurs villages.

vi.L: Và Cát-tát, và Na-ha-la, và Sim-rôn, và Di-đê-a-la, và Bết-lê-hem: mười hai thành cùng các làng của chúng.
vi.B: Trong đó cũng có Cát-tát, Na-ha-la, Sim-rôn, Di-đê-a-la và Bết-lê-hem: mười hai thị trấn cùng các làng của chúng.
vi.R: Đất của họ cũng gồm Cát-tát, Na-ha-la, Sim-rôn, Di-đê-a-la và Bết-lê-hem. Tất cả có mười hai thị trấn cùng các làng chung quanh.

ko.L: 그리고 갓닷과 나할랄과 시므론과 이달라와 베들레헴이니, 열두 성읍과 그 마을들이다.
ko.B: 또 그 안에는 갓닷, 나할랄, 시므론, 이달라와 베들레헴이 있었으니, 열두 성읍과 그 마을들이다.
ko.R: 그들의 땅에는 또 갓닷, 나할랄, 시므론, 이달라, 베들레헴이 들어 있었다. 모두 합하여 열두 성읍과 그 주변 마을들이었다.

pt.L: E Catate, e Naalal, e Sinrom, e Idala, e Belém: doze cidades e as suas aldeias.
pt.B: Estavam também nela Catate, Naalal, Sinrom, Idala e Belém: doze cidades com as suas aldeias.
pt.R: A terra deles incluía também Catate, Naalal, Sinrom, Idala e Belém. Ao todo, eram doze cidades com as suas aldeias.

decisions.choice: twelve: a total that includes towns already named along the border
decisions.reason: Only five towns are named here. The total most likely counts towns named in the border too, such as Japhia, Daberath and Rimmon, but exactly which ones is no longer certain. The same is true of the totals in verses 22, 30 and 38.

decisions.choice: Bethlehem: a town of Zebulun, not the Bethlehem of Judah
decisions.reason: This is a second town of the same name, in Galilee, west of Nazareth. The Bethlehem of Ruth and David lies south of Jerusalem (Ruth 1:1; Micah 5:1).

decisions.choice: Also in it were / Its land also included
decisions.reason: The Hebrew adds the names with a plain "and". Balanced and Readable add a few words so the list reads as a sentence.

decisions.choice: the names of Zebulun's towns in their usual Spanish forms; "Belén" for this Bethlehem
decisions.reason: Every name is kept, as the terms note asks. This Bethlehem is a town of Zebulun in Galilee, not Bethlehem of Judah, but the Hebrew name is the same, so Spanish writes it "Belén" as it always does.

decisions.choice: "Bethléem" in its usual French form
decisions.reason: This is a town of Zebulun, not Bethlehem of Judah, but the Hebrew name is the same, and French keeps the one familiar spelling, as the terms note sets.

source.text: זֹ֛את נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־זְבוּלֻ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑ם הֶֽעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

records.literal_gloss: This [was the] inheritance of [the] sons of Zebulun by their clans, the cities the these and their villages.

en.L: This [was] the inheritance of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Zebulun by their clans, these cities and their villages.
en.B: This was the inheritance of the tribe of Zebulun, clan by clan: these towns and their villages.
en.R: This was the share of land that the tribe of Zebulun received, clan by clan: these towns and their villages.

sw.L: Huu [ndio] urithi wa wana wa Zabuloni kufuatana na koo zao, miji hii na vijiji vyake.
sw.B: Huu ndio urithi wa kabila la Zabuloni, ukoo kwa ukoo: miji hiyo na vijiji vyake.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo sehemu ya nchi ambayo kabila la Zabuloni lilipokea, ukoo kwa ukoo: miji hiyo na vijiji vyake.

es.L: Esta [es] la heredad de la tribu de los hijos de Zabulón conforme a sus clanes, estas ciudades y sus aldeas.
es.B: Esta fue la heredad de la tribu de Zabulón, clan por clan: estas poblaciones y sus aldeas.
es.R: Esta fue la parte de la tierra que recibió la tribu de Zabulón, clan por clan: estos pueblos y sus aldeas.

fr.L: Ceci [fut] l’héritage des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Zabulon selon leurs clans, ces villes et leurs villages.
fr.B: Tel fut l’héritage de la tribu de Zabulon, clan par clan : ces villes et leurs villages.
fr.R: Voilà la part de terre que la tribu de Zabulon a reçue, clan par clan : ces villes et leurs villages.

vi.L: Đây [là] sản nghiệp của chi tộc con cháu Sa-bu-lôn theo các gia tộc của họ, các thành và làng mạc của chúng.
vi.B: Đó là sản nghiệp của chi tộc Sa-bu-lôn, theo từng gia tộc: các thị trấn ấy cùng các làng của chúng.
vi.R: Đó là phần đất chi tộc Sa-bu-lôn đã nhận, theo từng gia tộc: các thị trấn ấy cùng các làng của chúng.

ko.L: 이것이 스불론 자손 지파의 그들의 종족대로의 유산, 곧 이 성읍들과 그 마을들이다.
ko.B: 이것이 스불론 지파가 종족별로 받은 유산, 곧 이 성읍들과 그 마을들이다.
ko.R: 이것이 스불론 지파가 집안별로 받은 땅, 곧 이 성읍들과 그 주변 마을들이다.

pt.L: Esta [foi] a herança dos filhos de Zebulom, segundo os seus clãs, estas cidades e as suas aldeias.
pt.B: Esta foi a herança da tribo de Zebulom, clã por clã: estas cidades e as suas aldeias.
pt.R: Essa foi a parte da terra que a tribo de Zebulom recebeu, clã por clã: estas cidades e as suas aldeias.

decisions.choice: the closing words of the tribe's section

decisions.choice: Carmel and Shihor-libnath on the west
decisions.reason: Carmel is the mountain ridge that runs out to the sea, the place of Elijah's contest (1 Kings 18:19-20). Shihor-libnath was probably a stream near it; its site is not known, and the first part of the name is used of a river elsewhere (13:3).

decisions.choice: Mount Carmel; the border
decisions.reason: Readable adds "Mount" and names "the border" as the subject, which the Hebrew leaves to be understood.

sw.L: Na unageuka kuelekea mawio ya jua hadi Beth-dagoni, na kugusa Zabuloni, na bonde la Ifta-eli kuelekea kaskazini, Beth-emeki, na Neieli, na kutokea Kabuli upande wa kushoto,

fr.B: Puis elle tourne vers l’est, vers le soleil levant, jusqu’à Beth-Dagon, atteint Zabulon et la vallée de Jiphtah-El au nord, Beth-Émek et Neïel, et continue vers Kaboul, au nord,
fr.R: Ensuite, la frontière tournait vers l’est jusqu’à Beth-Dagon. Elle arrivait au pays de Zabulon et à la vallée de Jiphtah-El, au nord, et à Beth-Émek et Neïel. Puis elle allait vers le nord jusqu’à Kaboul,

pt.B: Depois ela volta para o leste, para o nascer do sol, até Bete-Dagom, chega a Zebulom e ao vale de Iftá-El, ao norte, a Bete-Emeque e a Neiel, e segue até Cabul, ao norte,

decisions.choice: on the left: on the north
decisions.reason: Directions were given facing the sunrise, so the left hand was the north and the right hand the south (Genesis 14:15).

decisions.choice: Beth-dagon and Cabul
decisions.reason: Beth-dagon means "house of Dagon", a god worshiped on the coast (Judges 16:23); this is not the town of the same name in Judah (15:41). Cabul was among the towns Solomon later gave to Hiram king of Tyre (1 Kings 9:11-13).

decisions.choice: on the north / went north
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "north" for "left", as the meaning decision explains. Literal keeps "on the left".

decisions.choice: "a la izquierda" (L); "por el norte" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Hebrew names the north as "the left hand", facing east. Literal keeps the word; Balanced and Readable say "north", as the English does. The Carmel is "el Carmelo", its usual Spanish name.

decisions.choice: "à gauche" kept at Literal
decisions.reason: For someone facing east, as Hebrew orients itself, the left hand is the north, as the right is the south in 17:7. Literal keeps the picture; Balanced and Readable say "au nord", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "về bên trái" at Literal; "ở phía bắc" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Facing east, the left hand is the north (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, as in 17:7 it keeps "the right".

decisions.choice: "왼쪽으로" (L); "북쪽으로" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Facing east, the left hand is the north (meaning decision m1), as "the right" is the south in 17:7. Literal keeps the Hebrew way of saying it; Balanced and Readable give the direction.

decisions.choice: à esquerda (L); ao norte (B), para o norte (R)
decisions.reason: Directions were given facing the sunrise, so the left hand is the north (m1). Literal keeps "à esquerda", as the English Literal keeps "on the left"; Balanced and Readable say the direction.

decisions.choice: Ebron: kept as in the Hebrew text; many manuscripts read Abdon
decisions.reason: Many Hebrew manuscripts have "Abdon", the name of the Levite town of Asher (21:30; 1 Chronicles 6:59). In Hebrew writing the letters for d and r look very much alike, so one name could easily become the other. The text followed here has Ebron.

decisions.choice: great Sidon: the leading city of the Phoenician coast
decisions.reason: Sidon was the chief city of the coast north of Tyre; "great" probably takes in the lands around it (11:8). The border ran toward its territory, but Asher never drove out its people (Judges 1:31).

decisions.choice: the fortified city of Tyre
decisions.reason: Tyre was a strong Phoenician port, built on an island just off the coast with a town on the shore. Asher's border ran near it, but Tyre was never Israel's (2 Samuel 24:7 calls it a stronghold).

decisions.choice: from the region toward Achzib: the area around Achzib
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is short and hard. The word after "from" usually means a measured stretch of land, so the phrase most likely places the end of the border near Achzib, a town on the coast south of Tyre (Judges 1:31). The same letters can also be read as the name of a town, Mahalab, which ancient Assyrian records place on this coast; the line would then run "from Mahalab to Achzib".

decisions.choice: ends the sentence here
decisions.reason: Readable closes the sentence at Achzib and gives the last towns and the total in verse 30 as a sentence of their own. Literal and Balanced run on into verse 30.

decisions.reason: As with Zebulun (verse 15), the total takes in towns named along the border, and how the count was made is no longer certain.

decisions.choice: Aphek and Rehob in Asher
decisions.reason: This Aphek is not the town of the same name in the south (12:18). Rehob is also named in verse 28; there may have been two towns called Rehob. Judges 1:31 names both among the towns whose people Asher did not drive out.

decisions.choice: and also / were also theirs

ko.R: 그들의 경계는 헬렙과 사아난님의 큰 나무에서 시작하여, 아다미 네겝과 얍느엘을 지나 락굼까지 갔다. 그리고 요단강에서 끝났다.

pt.R: A fronteira deles ia de Helefe e da grande árvore de Zaananim, passando por Adami-Nequebe e Jabneel, até Lacum. Ela terminava no rio Jordão.

decisions.choice: the great tree: a large oak or terebinth that marked the place
decisions.reason: The word names a large, long-lived tree, often a landmark or a place of worship (Genesis 12:6; 13:18). Which kind of tree is not certain. The words have also been read as the name of a place, Elon-bezaanannim.

decisions.choice: the tree in Zaanannim: where Heber the Kenite camped
decisions.reason: Judges 4:11 says Heber pitched his tent "as far as the great tree in Zaanannim, near Kedesh". It was near his tent that Sisera died (Judges 4:17-21).

decisions.choice: great tree
decisions.reason: All three levels say "great tree", not "oak", because the kind of tree is not certain.

decisions.choice: "el gran árbol"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word names a large, notable tree whose kind is not certain; Spanish says "el gran árbol", as the English says "great tree", rather than naming a kind of oak.

decisions.choice: "le grand arbre" for the elon
decisions.reason: As the English "great tree": the Hebrew word names a large tree, perhaps an oak or a terebinth, and the kind is not certain. French says what is sure.

decisions.choice: "cây lớn" for the great tree
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word names a large tree, an oak or a terebinth (meaning decision); "cây lớn" leaves the kind open, as the English "great tree" does.

decisions.choice: "큰 나무" for the great tree at Zaanannim
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names a large tree that marked the place, an oak or a terebinth (meaning decision m1); Korean says "큰 나무" rather than choose one kind, as the English says "great tree".

decisions.choice: a grande árvore (every level)
decisions.reason: As the English says "great tree" at every level (r-en-1): the kind of tree is not certain (m1), so Portuguese does not name it.

records.literal_gloss: And turns back the border westward [to] Aznoth-tabor, and goes out from there to Hukkok; and touches on Zebulun from [the] south, and on Asher touches from [the] west, and on Judah [at] the Jordan [toward the] rising of the sun.

sw.L: Na mpaka unageuka kuelekea magharibi hadi Aznoth-tabori, na kutokea huko hadi Hukoki, na kugusa Zabuloni upande wa kusini, na kugusa Asheri upande wa magharibi, na Yuda [kwenye] Yordani kuelekea mawio ya jua.
sw.B: Kisha mpaka unageuka magharibi hadi Aznoth-tabori na kuendelea kutoka huko hadi Hukoki. Unafika Zabuloni upande wa kusini na Asheri upande wa magharibi, na upande wa mashariki unafika Yuda kwenye Yordani.

es.L: Y gira la frontera al occidente hacia Aznot-tabor, y sale de allí a Hucoc, y toca Zabulón por el sur, y toca Aser por el occidente, y Judá [en] el Jordán, hacia la salida del sol.

es.R: Después la frontera giraba al oeste hacia Aznot-tabor y seguía hasta Hucoc. Llegaba a la tierra de Zabulón por el sur y a la tierra de Aser por el oeste. Por el este llegaba a Judá, en el río Jordán.

fr.L: Et la frontière tourne vers l’occident vers Aznoth-Thabor, et sort de là vers Houkkok, et touche Zabulon au sud, et touche Aser à l’occident, et Juda [au] Jourdain, vers le lever du soleil.

fr.R: Ensuite, la frontière tournait vers l’ouest jusqu’à Aznoth-Thabor et continuait jusqu’à Houkkok. Elle touchait le pays de Zabulon au sud et le pays d’Aser à l’ouest. À l’est, elle touchait Juda au Jourdain.

vi.R: Rồi ranh giới quay về phía tây đến Át-nốt-Tha-bô và đi tiếp đến Hục-cốc. Nó giáp đất Sa-bu-lôn ở phía nam và đất A-se ở phía tây. Ở phía đông, nó giáp Giu-đa tại sông Giô-đanh.

decisions.choice: and Judah at the Jordan: kept as in the Hebrew text
alternatives: and at the Jordan on the east
decisions.reason: Judah's land lay far to the south, so it is hard to see how it could touch Naphtali. The ancient Greek translation does not have "Judah" here, and some think the word came in by a copying slip. Others suggest it refers to a group counted with Judah living near the Jordan, such as the towns of Jair (1 Chronicles 2:21-22). The Hebrew text is followed. This note is from general knowledge of the Greek translation and should be checked by a reviewer.

records.literal_gloss: And went out [the] territory of [the] sons of Dan from them; and went up [the] sons of Dan and fought with Leshem, and captured it and struck it to [the] mouth of [the] sword, and took possession of it and lived in it; and called Leshem Dan, according to [the] name of Dan their father.

en.L: And the territory of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Dan went out from them. And the sons of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and captured it, and struck it with the mouth of the sword, and took possession of it, and lived in it; and they called Leshem Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
en.B: But the territory of the Danites was lost to them, so the Danites went up and fought against Leshem. They captured it, put it to the sword, took possession of it, and settled there. They renamed Leshem Dan, after their ancestor Dan.
en.R: But the tribe of Dan lost control of its land. So the Danites went north and attacked the town of Leshem. They captured it and killed its people with their swords. Then they took it over and settled there. They named it Dan, after Dan, the father of their tribe.

sw.L: Na eneo la wana wa Dani likatoka kwao. Na wana wa Dani wakapanda wakapigana na Leshemu, wakauteka, wakaupiga kwa kinywa cha upanga, wakaumiliki, wakakaa ndani yake; wakauita Leshemu Dani, kwa jina la Dani baba yao.
sw.B: Lakini Wadani walipoteza eneo lao, kwa hiyo Wadani walipanda wakapigana na Leshemu. Waliuteka, wakawaua watu wake kwa upanga, wakaumiliki na kukaa humo. Wakaubadilisha jina Leshemu kuwa Dani, kwa jina la Dani baba yao wa zamani.
sw.R: Lakini kabila la Dani lilishindwa kuitawala nchi yake. Kwa hiyo Wadani walikwenda kaskazini wakaushambulia mji wa Leshemu. Waliuteka na kuwaua watu wake kwa upanga. Kisha wakauchukua, wakakaa humo. Wakauita Dani, kwa jina la Dani, baba wa kabila lao.

es.L: Y el territorio de los hijos de Dan se les salió de las manos. Y subieron los hijos de Dan y combatieron contra Lesem, y la tomaron, y la hirieron a filo de espada, y tomaron posesión de ella, y habitaron en ella; y llamaron a Lesem Dan, conforme al nombre de Dan su padre.
es.B: Pero los danitas perdieron su territorio, así que subieron y combatieron contra Lesem. La tomaron, la pasaron a filo de espada, tomaron posesión de ella y se establecieron allí. A Lesem le pusieron el nombre de Dan, por su antepasado Dan.
es.R: Pero la tribu de Dan perdió el control de su tierra. Así que los danitas fueron al norte y atacaron el pueblo de Lesem. Lo conquistaron y mataron a su gente a espada. Después lo tomaron y se establecieron allí. Le pusieron el nombre de Dan, por Dan, el padre de su tribu.

fr.L: Et le territoire des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Dan sortit d’entre leurs mains. Et les fils de Dan montèrent, et combattirent contre Léshem, et la prirent, et la frappèrent du tranchant de l’épée, et en prirent possession, et y habitèrent ; et ils appelèrent Léshem Dan, d’après le nom de Dan, leur père.
fr.B: Mais le territoire des Danites leur échappa. Les Danites montèrent donc combattre contre Léshem. Ils la prirent, la passèrent au fil de l’épée, en prirent possession et s’y établirent. Ils appelèrent Léshem Dan, du nom de leur ancêtre Dan.
fr.R: Mais la tribu de Dan a perdu le contrôle de son pays. Alors les Danites sont montés vers le nord et ont attaqué la ville de Léshem. Ils l’ont prise et ont tué ses habitants avec leurs épées. Puis ils s’en sont emparés et s’y sont installés. Ils l’ont appelée Dan, du nom de Dan, le père de leur tribu.

vi.L: Địa phận của con cháu Đan đã ra khỏi tay họ. Con cháu Đan đi lên đánh Lê-sem, chiếm được nó, đánh nó bằng lưỡi gươm, chiếm hữu nó và ở tại đó; họ gọi Lê-sem là Đan, theo tên Đan, tổ phụ của họ.
vi.B: Nhưng người Đan mất địa phận của mình, nên họ đi lên đánh Lê-sem. Họ chiếm thành ấy, dùng gươm giết dân trong thành, chiếm hữu nó và định cư tại đó. Họ đổi tên Lê-sem thành Đan, theo tên tổ phụ mình là Đan.
vi.R: Nhưng chi tộc Đan không giữ được đất của mình. Vì thế người Đan đi lên phía bắc tấn công thị trấn Lê-sem. Họ chiếm thị trấn ấy và dùng gươm giết dân trong thành. Rồi họ chiếm lấy nơi ấy và định cư ở đó. Họ đặt tên cho nó là Đan, theo tên Đan, ông tổ của chi tộc họ.

ko.L: 그리고 단 자손의 지역이 그들에게서 나갔다. 그리고 단 자손이 올라가서 레센과 싸워 그것을 점령하고, 칼날로 그것을 쳐서 그것을 차지하고 거기에 살았다. 그리고 그들이 레센을 그들의 조상 단의 이름을 따라 단이라 불렀다.
ko.B: 그러나 단 자손은 자기 지역을 잃었다. 그래서 단 자손은 올라가서 레센과 싸웠다. 그들은 그 성읍을 점령하여 칼로 치고, 차지하여 거기에 자리 잡았다. 그리고 레센을 그들의 조상 단의 이름을 따라 단이라고 고쳐 불렀다.
ko.R: 그러나 단 지파는 자기 땅을 지키지 못하였다. 그래서 단 자손은 북쪽으로 올라가서 레센 성읍을 공격하였다. 그들은 그 성읍을 점령하고 그 주민을 칼로 죽였다. 그리고 그 성읍을 차지하여 거기에 자리 잡고 살았다. 그들은 자기 지파의 조상인 단의 이름을 따서 그 성읍을 단이라고 불렀다.

pt.L: E o território dos filhos de Dã saiu deles. E os filhos de Dã subiram, e lutaram contra Lésem, e a tomaram, e a feriram ao fio da espada, e tomaram posse dela, e habitaram nela; e chamaram Lésem de Dã, segundo o nome de Dã, o pai deles.
pt.B: Mas os danitas perderam o seu território. Por isso, os danitas subiram e lutaram contra Lésem. Eles a conquistaram, passaram a cidade ao fio da espada, tomaram posse dela e se estabeleceram ali. Deram a Lésem o nome de Dã, por causa do seu antepassado Dã.
pt.R: Mas a tribo de Dã perdeu o controle da sua terra. Por isso, os danitas foram para o norte e atacaram a cidade de Lésem. Eles a conquistaram e mataram o seu povo à espada. Depois tomaram posse da cidade e foram morar ali. Eles deram à cidade o nome de Dã, por causa de Dã, o pai da tribo deles.

decisions.choice: the territory went out from them: the land slipped out of their control
alternatives: the territory of the Danites went out beyond these towns
decisions.reason: The words most likely mean that Dan's land was lost to them, as Judges 1:34 tells: the Amorites forced the Danites into the hills and kept them from the plain. They can also mean that the territory reached out beyond the towns just listed. The ancient Greek translation reads differently again, saying that the Danites did not drive out the Amorites who pressed them. This note is from general knowledge of the Greek translation and should be checked by a reviewer.

decisions.choice: Leshem renamed Dan: the story of Judges 18
decisions.reason: Leshem is the Laish of Judges 18, a quiet town far to the north near the springs of the Jordan. Judges 18 tells how the Danites sent spies, attacked it and renamed it Dan. This note looks ahead to events after the time of the allotments; the town later marks Israel's northern limit, "from Dan to Beersheba" (Judges 20:1).

decisions.choice: struck it to the mouth of the sword: killed its people with the sword
decisions.reason: The sword is pictured as a mouth that devours (Deuteronomy 32:42). "Struck it" means the town's people (Judges 18:27).

decisions.choice: Dan their father: Jacob's son, the tribe's ancestor
decisions.reason: Dan was the son of Jacob and Bilhah (Genesis 30:6), from whom the tribe was descended.

decisions.choice: the sons of Dan / the Danites
decisions.reason: Literal gives the first "sons of Dan", the tribe whose land it was, with the gender setting; the second names the men who went to war, so it has no setting. Balanced and Readable say "the Danites" for both.

decisions.choice: went north
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "went up". Readable says "went north", since Leshem lay in the far north (Judges 18:7, 29), and "killed its people" for "struck it".

decisions.choice: "a filo de espada" (L, B); "a espada" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "to the mouth of the sword". Spanish has its own fixed phrase for the same picture, "a filo de espada" ("by the edge of the sword"), which Literal and Balanced use; Readable says it plainly. Literal "se les salió de las manos" renders "went out from them" as the meaning decisions read it, the land slipping from their control.

decisions.choice: "los danitas" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "los danitas", the people of the tribe of Dan, as the English says "the Danites"; Literal keeps "los hijos de Dan".

decisions.choice: "sortit d'entre leurs mains" at Literal for "went out from them"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says the territory "went out from them", that is, slipped out of their control. French "sortit d'eux" would not be understood; Literal adds "leurs mains" in the French idiom for losing hold of something.

decisions.choice: "그들에게서 나갔다" (L); "잃었다" (B); "지키지 못하였다" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says the territory "went out from them", that it slipped out of their control (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the words; Balanced and Readable say what happened.

decisions.choice: saiu deles (L); perderam o seu território (B); perdeu o controle da sua terra (R); ao fio da espada (L, B), à espada (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "went out from them", which Portuguese can read either way (m1); Balanced and Readable give the likelier sense, as the English does. The sword phrase keeps the wording 8:24 sets in Portuguese. "Os danitas" (B, R) follows "rubenitas" and "gaditas" (1:12); Literal keeps "os filhos de Dã" with no gender setting.

fr.B: Tel fut l’héritage de la tribu de Dan, clan par clan : ces villes et leurs villages.
fr.R: Voilà la part de terre que la tribu de Dan a reçue, clan par clan : ces villes et leurs villages.

vi.L: Đây [là] sản nghiệp của chi tộc con cháu Đan theo các gia tộc của họ, các thành và làng mạc của chúng.
vi.B: Đó là sản nghiệp của chi tộc Đan, theo từng gia tộc: các thị trấn ấy cùng các làng của chúng.
vi.R: Đó là phần đất chi tộc Đan đã nhận, theo từng gia tộc: các thị trấn ấy cùng các làng của chúng.

ko.L: 이것이 단 자손 지파의 그들의 종족대로의 유산, 곧 이 성읍들과 그 마을들이다.
ko.B: 이것이 단 지파가 종족별로 받은 유산, 곧 이 성읍들과 그 마을들이다.
ko.R: 이것이 단 지파가 집안별로 받은 땅, 곧 이 성읍들과 그 주변 마을들이다.

pt.L: Esta [foi] a herança da tribo dos filhos de Dã, segundo os seus clãs, estas cidades e as suas aldeias.
pt.B: Esta foi a herança da tribo de Dã, clã por clã: estas cidades e as suas aldeias.
pt.R: Essa foi a parte da terra que a tribo de Dã recebeu, clã por clã: estas cidades e as suas aldeias.

decisions.choice: the closing words of the tribe's section
decisions.reason: As in verse 8: the summary that ends each tribe's allotment. It closes the list of verses 41-46, after the note of verse 47.

decisions.choice: the tribe of Dan; share of land
decisions.reason: As in verse 1.

source.text: וַיְכַלּ֥וּ לִנְחֹל־אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ לִגְבֽוּלֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל נַחֲלָ֛ה לִיהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן־נ֖וּן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they finished dividing for inheritance the land by its borders; and gave [the] sons of Israel an inheritance to Joshua son of Nun in their midst.

en.L: And they finished dividing the land for inheritance by its borders, and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua son of Nun in their midst.
en.B: When they had finished dividing up the land as inheritances by its borders, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them.
en.R: When all the land had been divided up, each part within its borders, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} gave Joshua son of Nun a share of land among them.

sw.L: Na wakamaliza kuigawa nchi kuwa urithi kwa mipaka yake, na wana wa Israeli wakampa Yoshua mwana wa Nuni urithi katikati yao.
sw.B: Walipokwisha kuigawa nchi kuwa urithi kwa mipaka yake, Waisraeli walimpa Yoshua mwana wa Nuni urithi kati yao.
sw.R: Nchi yote ilipokwisha kugawanywa, kila sehemu ndani ya mipaka yake, Waisraeli walimpa Yoshua mwana wa Nuni sehemu ya nchi kati yao.

es.L: Y terminaron de repartir la tierra en heredad por sus fronteras, y los hijos de Israel dieron heredad a Josué hijo de Nun en medio de ellos.
es.B: Cuando terminaron de repartir la tierra en heredades según sus fronteras, los israelitas dieron a Josué hijo de Nun una heredad entre ellos.
es.R: Cuando toda la tierra quedó repartida, cada parte dentro de sus fronteras, los israelitas le dieron a Josué hijo de Nun una parte de la tierra entre ellos.

fr.L: Et ils achevèrent de partager le pays en héritage selon ses frontières, et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël donnèrent un héritage à Josué fils de Noun au milieu d’eux.
fr.B: Quand ils eurent fini de partager le pays en héritages selon ses frontières, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} donnèrent à Josué fils de Noun un héritage au milieu d’eux.
fr.R: Quand tout le pays a été partagé, chaque part avec ses frontières, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont donné à Josué fils de Noun une part de terre au milieu d’eux.

vi.L: Họ đã chia xong xứ làm sản nghiệp theo các ranh giới của nó, và con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên ban cho Giô-suê con trai Nun một sản nghiệp ở giữa họ.
vi.B: Khi đã chia xong xứ làm sản nghiệp theo các ranh giới, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ban cho Giô-suê con trai Nun một sản nghiệp ở giữa họ.
vi.R: Khi toàn bộ đất đã được chia xong, mỗi phần trong ranh giới của nó, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ban cho Giô-suê con trai Nun một phần đất ở giữa họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그 땅을 그 경계대로 유산으로 나누기를 마쳤다. 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 그들 가운데서 눈의 아들 여호수아에게 유산을 주었다.
ko.B: 그들이 그 땅을 경계에 따라 유산으로 다 나누고 나서, 이스라엘 자손은 자기들 가운데서 눈의 아들 여호수아에게 유산을 주었다.
ko.R: 그 땅이 경계에 따라 모두 나뉘자, 이스라엘 백성은 자기들 가운데서 눈의 아들 여호수아에게도 땅을 주었다.

pt.L: E acabaram de repartir a terra como herança segundo as suas fronteiras; e os filhos de Israel deram uma herança a Josué, filho de Num, no meio deles.
pt.B: Quando acabaram de repartir a terra como herança, de acordo com as suas fronteiras, os israelitas deram a Josué, filho de Num, uma herança no meio deles.
pt.R: Quando toda a terra foi dividida, cada parte dentro das suas fronteiras, os israelitas deram a Josué, filho de Num, uma parte da terra no meio deles.

decisions.choice: dividing for inheritance: handing out the land as lasting possessions
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the same root as "inheritance". It means to give out land as property that each tribe and family would keep.

decisions.choice: Joshua receives his share last
decisions.reason: The leader is given his own land only after every tribe has received its share. Caleb, the other faithful spy, had also received his land by promise (14:6-15).

decisions.choice: When they had finished ...
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the first clause a time clause, since the gift to Joshua comes after the division is done.

source.text: עַל־פִּ֨י יְהוָ֜ה נָ֣תְנוּ ל֗וֹ אֶת־הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔ל אֶת־תִּמְנַת־סֶ֖רַח בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיִּבְנֶ֥ה אֶת־הָעִ֖יר וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: At [the] mouth of Yahweh they gave to him the city which he asked, Timnath-serah in [the] hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city and lived in it.

en.L: At the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} they gave him the city that he asked for, Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, and he built the city and lived in it.
en.B: At the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} they gave him the town he asked for, Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim. He built up the town and settled there.
en.R: As {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded, they gave him the town he asked for. It was Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim. Joshua built up the town and lived there.

sw.L: Kwa kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakampa mji aliouomba, Timnath-sera katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu, naye akaujenga mji akakaa ndani yake.
sw.B: Kwa agizo la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} walimpa mji aliouomba, Timnath-sera katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu. Aliujenga upya mji huo, akakaa humo.
sw.R: Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa ameamuru, walimpa mji aliouomba. Ulikuwa Timnath-sera katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu. Yoshua aliujenga upya mji huo, akaishi humo.

es.L: Conforme a la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} le dieron la ciudad que pidió, Timnat-sera, en la región montañosa de Efraín; y él edificó la ciudad y habitó en ella.
es.B: Por orden {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} le dieron la población que pidió, Timnat-sera, en la región montañosa de Efraín. Él reconstruyó la población y se estableció allí.
es.R: Tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado, le dieron el pueblo que pidió. Era Timnat-sera, en la región montañosa de Efraín. Josué reconstruyó el pueblo y vivió allí.

fr.L: Selon la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, ils lui donnèrent la ville qu’il demanda, Timnath-Sérah, dans la montagne d’Éphraïm ; et il bâtit la ville et y habita.
fr.B: Sur l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, ils lui donnèrent la ville qu’il avait demandée, Timnath-Sérah, dans la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm. Il rebâtit la ville et s’y établit.
fr.R: Comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné, ils lui ont donné la ville qu’il avait demandée. C’était Timnath-Sérah, dans la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm. Josué a rebâti la ville et y a habité.

vi.L: Theo miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, họ ban cho ông thành ông đã xin, Thim-nát-Sê-rách trong miền núi Ép-ra-im; ông xây thành ấy và ở tại đó.
vi.B: Theo lệnh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, họ ban cho ông thị trấn ông đã xin, là Thim-nát-Sê-rách trong miền núi Ép-ra-im. Ông xây dựng lại thị trấn ấy và định cư tại đó.
vi.R: Như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền, họ ban cho ông thị trấn ông đã xin. Đó là Thim-nát-Sê-rách trong miền núi Ép-ra-im. Giô-suê xây dựng lại thị trấn ấy và sống ở đó.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령대로 그들이 그가 구한 성읍, 곧 에브라임 산지에 있는 딤낫 세라를 그에게 주었다. 그리고 그가 그 성읍을 건축하고 거기에 살았다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령에 따라 그들은 여호수아가 구한 성읍, 곧 에브라임 산지에 있는 딤낫 세라를 그에게 주었다. 여호수아는 그 성읍을 다시 세우고 거기에 자리 잡았다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 명령하신 대로, 그들은 여호수아가 달라고 한 성읍을 그에게 주었다. 그것은 에브라임 산지에 있는 딤낫 세라였다. 여호수아는 그 성읍을 새로 세우고 거기에서 살았다.

pt.L: Segundo a boca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, deram-lhe a cidade que ele pediu, Timnate-Sera, na região montanhosa de Efraim; e ele edificou a cidade e habitou nela.
pt.B: Por ordem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, deram a ele a cidade que ele tinha pedido, Timnate-Sera, na região montanhosa de Efraim. Ele reconstruiu a cidade e se estabeleceu ali.
pt.R: Como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha ordenado, eles deram a Josué a cidade que ele pediu. Era Timnate-Sera, na região montanhosa de Efraim. Josué reconstruiu a cidade e foi morar ali.

decisions.choice: at the mouth of the LORD: by the LORD's command
decisions.reason: "Mouth" stands for what someone says. The phrase means "at the LORD's word" or "by his order" (Numbers 3:16; 9:18). The command itself is not recorded; Joshua, like Caleb, had been promised that he would enter the land (Numbers 14:30).

decisions.choice: Timnath-serah in Ephraim
decisions.reason: Joshua belonged to the tribe of Ephraim (Numbers 13:8). He was buried in this town (24:30), which Judges 2:9 calls Timnath-heres.

decisions.choice: built: rebuilt or strengthened
decisions.reason: The verb can mean building a town anew or building up one that already stood, by repairing and fortifying it.

decisions.choice: built up
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "built up", which fits either sense; Literal keeps "built".

decisions.choice: "Theo miệng CHÚA" at Literal; "theo lệnh" (Balanced); "như CHÚA đã truyền" (Readable)
decisions.reason: "At the mouth of" means by the LORD's command (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Timnate-Sera; edificou (L), reconstruiu (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 24:30): the name in the Brazilian pattern of the book's other compounds, "-ate" for the construct ending and no final h. The verb can mean building anew or building up (m3); Literal says "edificou", Balanced and Readable "reconstruiu", as the English says "built up".

source.text: אֵ֣לֶּה הַנְּחָלֹ֡ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִחֲל֣וּ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֣ן׀וִיהוֹשֻׁ֪עַ בִּן־נ֟וּן וְרָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֣וֹת לְמַטּוֹת֩ בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל׀בְּגוֹרָ֤ל׀בְּשִׁלֹה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיְכַלּ֕וּ מֵֽחַלֵּ֖ק אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: These [are] the inheritances which gave as possession Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and [the] heads of the fathers of [the] tribes of [the] sons of Israel by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, [at the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting; and they finished from dividing the land.

en.L: These [are] the inheritances that Eleazar the priest, and Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel gave as possessions by lot in Shiloh before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, at the entrance of the tent of meeting. And they finished dividing the land.
en.B: Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the family heads of the tribes of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} handed out these inheritances by lot at Shiloh, before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at the entrance of the tent of meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
en.R: Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the family leaders of the tribes of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} gave out these shares of land. They drew lots at Shiloh, in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at the entrance of the meeting tent. So they finished dividing up the land.

sw.L: Hii [ndiyo] mirathi ambayo Eleazari kuhani, na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na wakuu wa baba wa makabila ya wana wa Israeli waliigawa kuwa milki kwa kura huko Shilo mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mlangoni pa Hema la Kukutania. Nao wakamaliza kuigawa nchi.
sw.B: Eleazari kuhani, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na wakuu wa jamaa za makabila ya Waisraeli waligawa mirathi hii kwa kura huko Shilo, mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mlangoni pa Hema la Kukutania. Hivyo wakamaliza kuigawa nchi.
sw.R: Eleazari kuhani, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na viongozi wa jamaa za makabila ya Waisraeli waligawa sehemu hizi za nchi. Walipiga kura huko Shilo, mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mlangoni pa Hema la Kukutania. Hivyo wakamaliza kuigawa nchi.

es.L: Estas [son] las heredades que el sacerdote Eleazar, y Josué hijo de Nun, y las cabezas de los padres de las tribus de los hijos de Israel repartieron por suerte en Silo delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro. Y terminaron de repartir la tierra.
es.B: El sacerdote Eleazar, Josué hijo de Nun y los jefes de familia de las tribus de los israelitas repartieron estas heredades por suerte en Silo, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro. Así terminaron de repartir la tierra.
es.R: El sacerdote Eleazar, Josué hijo de Nun y los jefes de las familias de las tribus de los israelitas repartieron estas partes de la tierra. Echaron suertes en Silo, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro. Así terminaron de repartir la tierra.

fr.L: Ce [sont] les héritages qu’Éléazar le prêtre, et Josué fils de Noun, et les chefs des pères des tribus des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël donnèrent en possession par le sort à Silo, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre. Et ils achevèrent de partager le pays.
fr.B: Éléazar le prêtre, Josué fils de Noun et les chefs de famille des tribus des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} distribuèrent ces héritages par le sort à Silo, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre. Ils achevèrent ainsi le partage du pays.
fr.R: Éléazar le prêtre, Josué fils de Noun et les chefs de famille des tribus des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont distribué ces parts de terre. Ils ont tiré au sort à Silo, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre. C’est ainsi qu’ils ont fini de partager le pays.

vi.L: Đó [là] các sản nghiệp mà thầy tế lễ Ê-lê-a-sa, Giô-suê con trai Nun và các trưởng tộc của các chi tộc con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên đã chia bằng thăm tại Si-lô trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tại cửa Lều Hội Kiến. Vậy họ đã chia xong xứ.
vi.B: Thầy tế lễ Ê-lê-a-sa, Giô-suê con trai Nun và các trưởng tộc của các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên đã bắt thăm chia các sản nghiệp này tại Si-lô, trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tại cửa Lều Hội Kiến. Vậy họ đã chia xong xứ.
vi.R: Thầy tế lễ Ê-lê-a-sa, Giô-suê con trai Nun và những người đứng đầu các gia đình trong các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên đã chia các phần đất này. Họ bắt thăm tại Si-lô, trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tại cửa Lều Hội Kiến. Vậy họ đã chia xong đất.

ko.L: 이것들은 제사장 엘르아살과 눈의 아들 여호수아와 이스라엘 자손 지파들의 가문의 우두머리들이 실로에서 회막 문 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 제비 뽑아 나누어 준 유산이다. 그리고 그들이 그 땅 나누기를 마쳤다.
ko.B: 제사장 엘르아살과 눈의 아들 여호수아와 이스라엘 자손 지파들의 가문 우두머리들은 실로에서, 회막 어귀 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 제비를 뽑아 이 유산들을 나누어 주었다. 이렇게 하여 그들은 땅 나누기를 마쳤다.
ko.R: 제사장 엘르아살과 눈의 아들 여호수아와 이스라엘 지파들의 집안 지도자들이 이렇게 땅을 나누어 주었다. 그들은 실로에서, 회막 입구 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 제비를 뽑았다. 이렇게 하여 그들은 땅 나누기를 모두 마쳤다.

pt.L: Estas [são] as heranças que o sacerdote Eleazar, e Josué, filho de Num, e os chefes dos pais das tribos dos filhos de Israel repartiram por sorte em Siló, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, à entrada da tenda do encontro. E acabaram de repartir a terra.
pt.B: O sacerdote Eleazar, Josué, filho de Num, e os chefes das famílias das tribos dos israelitas repartiram estas heranças lançando sortes em Siló, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, à entrada da tenda do encontro. Assim terminaram de repartir a terra.
pt.R: O sacerdote Eleazar, Josué, filho de Num, e os líderes das famílias das tribos dos israelitas repartiram essas partes da terra. Eles lançaram sortes em Siló, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, à entrada da tenda do encontro. Assim terminaram de dividir a terra.

decisions.choice: Eleazar, Joshua and the family heads: the leaders named for this task
decisions.reason: The LORD had named these leaders to divide the land: Eleazar the priest, Joshua, and one leader from each tribe (Numbers 34:16-29). The same group is named when the dividing begins (14:1).

decisions.choice: at Shiloh, before the LORD, at the tent of meeting
decisions.reason: The tent of meeting had been set up at Shiloh (18:1). To cast lots "before the LORD" at its entrance was to leave the outcome to him in his presence (18:6, 8, 10).

decisions.choice: the heads of the fathers: the heads of the ancestral families
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here means the family lines within a tribe; their heads were the tribe's leaders (Numbers 32:28).

decisions.choice: and they finished dividing the land: the close of the whole division
decisions.reason: The words repeat the start of verse 49 and close the account of the dividing of the land that began in 14:1.

decisions.choice: family heads / family leaders
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "families" for "fathers", following the meaning decision; Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: os chefes dos pais (L), os chefes das famílias (B), os líderes das famílias (R); por sorte (L), lançando sortes (B), lançaram sortes (R)
decisions.reason: The leaders keep the wording of Numbers 32:28 in Portuguese (m3). The lot keeps Numbers 26:55's "por sorte" at Literal; Balanced and Readable use the phrase of 18:6, "lançar sortes diante do SENHOR", which closes the account where it began (m2).
